bibliography.title: VGGT-Motion: Motion-Aware Calibration-Free Monocular SLAM for Long-Range Consistency

abstract_sentences.text: Despite recent progress in calibration-free monocular SLAM via 3D vision foundation models, scale drift remains severe on long sequences.

evidence.anchor: scale drift remains severe on long sequences

abstract_sentences.text: Motion-agnostic partitioning breaks contextual coherence and causes zero-motion drift, while conventional geometric alignment is computationally expensive.

evidence.anchor: Motion-agnostic partitioning breaks contextual coherence

abstract_sentences.text: To address these issues, we propose VGGT-Motion, a calibration-free SLAM system for efficient and robust global consistency over kilometer-scale trajectories.

evidence.anchor: a calibration-free SLAM system for efficient and robust global consistency

abstract_sentences.text: Specifically, we first propose a motion-aware submap construction mechanism that uses optical flow to guide adaptive partitioning, prune static redundancy, and encapsulate turns for stable local geometry.

evidence.anchor: uses optical flow to guide adaptive partitioning

abstract_sentences.text: We then design an anchor-driven direct Sim(3) registration strategy.

evidence.anchor: anchor-driven direct Sim(3) registration strategy

abstract_sentences.text: By exploiting context-balanced anchors, it achieves search-free, pixel-wise dense alignment and efficient loop closure without costly feature matching.

evidence.anchor: search-free, pixel-wise dense alignment

abstract_sentences.text: Finally, a lightweight submap-level pose graph optimization enforces global consistency with linear complexity, enabling scalable long-range operation.

evidence.anchor: enforces global consistency with linear complexity

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments show that VGGT-Motion markedly improves trajectory accuracy and efficiency, achieving state-of-the-art performance in zero-shot, long-range calibration-free monocular SLAM.

evidence.anchor: state-of-the-art performance in zero-shot, long-range

introduction_moves.move: context: 将 monocular visual SLAM 定位为 autonomous driving 基础任务，并转入经典方法条件。

evidence.anchor: Monocular visual SLAM is a cornerstone of autonomous driving

introduction_moves.move: problem: ORB-SLAM 等受照明、纹理、尺度和 calibration 约束，形成校准自由需求。

evidence.anchor: inherent scale ambiguity and strict calibration requirements

introduction_moves.move: context → missing_insight: 3D vision foundation models 联合推断 pose、intrinsics 和 dense geometry，但引出二次复杂度。

evidence.anchor: quadratic complexity (O(N²))

introduction_moves.move: failure_of_prior_work: sliding windows 与 simple chunking 改善可扩展性，却留下效率和 global consistency 缺口。

evidence.anchor: rigid adaptations improve scalability

introduction_moves.move: problem: 固定 partitioning 将 sharp turns 切入不同 submaps，丢失 attention context 并造成 scale jumps。

evidence.anchor: Geometric Fragmentation in Motion-Agnostic Partitioning

introduction_moves.move: problem: traffic stops 的 hallucinated displacement、动态帧 semantic saturation 与冗余共同放大成本。

evidence.anchor: Spatio-temporal Redundancy and Hallucinated Zero-Motion Drift

introduction_moves.move: problem: 前后 submap 的 near-field/far-field contextual asymmetry 转成 systematic translation error。

evidence.anchor: Contextual Asymmetry and Systematic Alignment Bias

introduction_moves.move: core_idea + method_preview: 用 motion dynamics、structural regularities、optical flow、anchors 和 sparse pose graph 组成方案。

evidence.anchor: exploit motion dynamics and structural regularities

introduction_moves.move: result_preview: 给出五个数据集、三个 zero-shot 长序列、85–95% error reduction 和 18–36× speedup。

evidence.anchor: 85–95% reduction in trajectory error

introduction_moves.move: contribution_list: 三条 bullet 回收 MASP、ADSR 和 calibration-free long-range framework。

evidence.anchor: In summary, our contributions are as follows

evidence.anchor: SfM & SLAM

related_work_moves.move: chronology + credit_or_foundation + limitation_of_prior: DUSt3R、MASt3R、FAST3R、VGGT 依次扩展 geometry、matching 和 inference，但受短序列二次 attention 限制。

evidence.anchor: 3D Foundation Models

related_work_moves.move: taxonomy + nearest_neighbor_contrast + gap_creation: streaming 与 submap registration 两路分别面对 forgetting/drift、redundancy、turn fragmentation 和 contextual asymmetry。

evidence.anchor: Scalable Foundation-Based SLAM

method_moves.move: setup_notation: 以 monocular image sequence 为输入，输出 globally consistent trajectory 与 dense geometry，并给出 Figure 2 三阶段总览。

evidence.anchor: recover a globally consistent trajectory and dense geometry

method_moves.move: state_problem: 把 naive temporal chunking 的 zero-motion drift 与 rotation-induced fragmentation 定义为预推断分组错误。

evidence.anchor: zero-motion drift during stop-and-go periods

method_moves.move: derive + define_component: dense optical flow 产生 static ratio、turning score，经 Gaussian smoothing 后分类 Static/Turning/Linear，见式 (1)–(3)。

evidence.anchor: assigns each frame a discrete state

method_moves.move: define_component + explain_mechanism: static boundary pruning 与 parallax keyframe selection 过滤噪声和窄基线。

evidence.anchor: only the boundary frames (first and last) are retained

method_moves.move: define_component + give_intuition: turning encapsulation 保持高曲率结构，linear slicing 用 Nmax 平衡 memory 与 local fidelity。

evidence.anchor: Continuous turning intervals are encapsulated into a single submap

method_moves.move: instantiate_algorithm: 式 (4) 增加 overlap/loop anchors，式 (5) 由 VGGT 输出 point maps、poses、confidence maps。

evidence.anchor: each base segment is augmented with auxiliary anchors

method_moves.move: state_problem + define_component: context-balanced overlap midpoint 与历史最高相似 loop frame 分别处理 boundary bias 和 loop closure。

evidence.anchor: compact temporal window surrounding the midpoint of W

method_moves.move: derive + connect_to_prediction: 共享 anchor 使 image lattice 像素索引直接形成 dense correspondence，式 (6)–(8) 建立 Sim(3) 关系。

evidence.anchor: each pixel index establishes a deterministic geometric correspondence

method_moves.move: define_component + derive: confidence/non-sky Ωvalid、Huber robust Sim(3) 与 inlier threshold 组成可靠性过滤，见式 (9)–(10)。

evidence.anchor: intersecting high-confidence regions with semantic non-sky areas

method_moves.move: instantiate_algorithm + derive: submap nodes/edges、Lie residual、weighted Huber LM 和 gauge fix 形成 pose graph，见式 (11)–(12)。

evidence.anchor: optimization is performed at the submap level

method_moves.move: connect_to_experiment + summarize: 式 (13) 将 local pose 组合到 global trajectory，收束为 sparse Sim(3) optimization。

evidence.anchor: This yields the full global trajectory

final_judgment.single_storyline: 用相机运动感知组织输入、以共享锚点直接做稠密 Sim(3) 对齐，再以稀疏子图图优化把局部 VGGT 几何连成长期轨迹（p.3–6，§3–3.3，Figure 2）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留三类失败机制、三段式系统、式 (1)–(13)、固定阈值和主基准/零样本/效率/消融结果；对应 p.1–9，§1–5、Tables 1–5。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录放 Algorithm 1、loop-keyframe reuse、model swap/SE(3)、TUM-Mono、全量轨迹/点云、3DGS discussion 与 limitations（p.12–22，Appendix A–C）。核心系统仍可从正文理解；扩展性与边界复核依赖附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效模式是把每个设计绑定到前文 failure mode，并用 Table 4/5 与 Figure 6 做增量或替代消融，再用 Figures 1/4/5 同时呈现误差、长度和运行代价（p.2、7–9）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 复杂度只有算法陈述，没有 theorem 或规模曲线；聚合结果没有不确定性。引言的 85–95% 区间未覆盖 A2D2 约 83.7% 降幅，Table 7 的 consistently 也被逐段反例削弱；B.3 承认 loop 间不能保证 bounded global error（p.7、14–15）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 把每个系统组件绑定到可观测失败机制，并让主表或主图与消融分别回答效果和机制，同时把失败分母、异质性和适用边界留在同一证据链中（p.2、7–9、15）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于有清晰输入组织、对齐和运行指标的长序列感知论文；单次平均 ATE/runtime、概念性模型替换或定性点云不能单独升级为普遍 guarantee，尤其在缺少重复运行、规模曲线和动态场景实验时（p.6–9、14–15）。
